title.narrative: Primary and Secondary School Tuition Sponsorship Program

description.narrative: An educational access initiative focused on empowering children from single-mother and guardian-led households in Wakiso District. The program reduces economic and social barriers by facilitating quality school placement, tuition sponsorship, academic monitoring, and basic scholastic material support.

activity-date.narrative: Projected start of the funding cycle

sector.narrative: Primary and secondary school tuition sponsorship for vulnerable scholars.

tag.narrative: Ensuring inclusive and equitable quality education and promoting lifelong learning opportunities for vulnerable scholars.

policy-marker.narrative: Targeting support to vulnerable children from single-mother and guardian-led households to promote equity.
